properties.evidence: The cause this repair addresses: `rule_id` on three tools was a bare string with no description, so nothing on the served surface said it resolves to EnvironmentRule rather than the DesignRule a caller holds. The repair states the type on all three, and generalises to every required reference parameter whose name cannot resolve. Drawn as CAUSES so `fix_without_recorded_cause` does not count this fix as unexplained — the design gate reported 3 of 263 fixes with no cause immediately after this change was recorded with only TRIGGERS edges. It addresses the SAYING half only; the missing edge path stays open on the fact.
